# JSONL snapshots

A JSONL source is one complete, authoritative UTF-8 snapshot. hSUM validates every nonblank line before returning any records, so a valid prefix of a bad source is never applied.

Generated from hSUM `0.1.0-alpha.4`.

- Source configuration schema: `1`
- Maximum snapshot file: `2147483648` bytes
- Maximum encoded line: `16777216` bytes
- Maximum `id`: `512` bytes
- Maximum `source_uri`: `4096` bytes
- Maximum `title`: `4096` bytes
- Maximum `content`: `2097152` bytes
- Maximum canonical metadata: `16384` bytes
- Maximum JSON nesting: `32` levels
- Maximum members in one array or object: `10000`

## Record forms

A live record requires nonempty `id`, `source_uri`, and `content`. Optional `title` is display text, optional `updated_at` is an RFC 3339 timestamp normalized to UTC, and optional `metadata` must be an object. Unknown fields and duplicate IDs are rejected. NUL bytes are forbidden in content.

```json
{"id":"doc-1","source_uri":"crm://case/1","content":"Immutable evidence body","title":"Case 1","updated_at":"2026-08-22T00:00:00Z","metadata":{"team":"alpha"}}
```

A deletion record may contain only `id`, `source_uri`, and `deleted: true`.

```json
{"id":"doc-2","source_uri":"crm://case/2","deleted":true}
```

## Source configuration

The source path must be absolute. A zero-byte index quota is invalid.

```json
{"index_quota_bytes":1073741824,"path":"/absolute/path/snapshot.jsonl","schema_version":1}
```

Each successful ingest applies the authoritative snapshot as one generation. Strict multi-source ingest refuses the batch when any source is invalid; non-strict mode records bounded source failures while committing the valid source outcomes atomically.
